about.heading: Portland Remodeling Built on Quality Craftsmanship.
paragraphs: Rip City Construction is a Portland remodeling contractor specializing in kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovations, ADU construction, home additions, basement finishing, and full residential remodeling throughout Portland and surrounding areas. Since 2012, we've built our business on quality workmanship, clear communication, and referrals from satisfied homeowners.
Our goal is to make the remodeling process organized, transparent, and well-managed from start to finish while delivering high-quality results built to last.
